### Wisdom from the Psalms 10/27
Author: Crosswalk.com
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/wisdom/wisdom-from-the-psalms-10-or-27-552656.html
Passage: Psalm 129:2
Points:
- Enduring hardship, physical affliction, and cruel mockery can severely damage a person's confidence and self-worth.
- Finding Christ provides renewed hope and the motivation to rise above painful past circumstances.
- Detractors and afflictions do not have the final say over our lives when we place our trust in God.
- Leaning on the Lord gives believers the strength and resilience needed to overcome limiting obstacles.
